summary: Creates and ends one scene's GPU content while a visible view references it: the body's core head, the V's details, motion and feature renderers.

faults.when: The masculine core can't be prepared; the feminine head is shown with a notice.
The head couldn't load; a plain reason and Try again.
The GL context was lost; the runtime is recreated when it is restored.

lifetime: Per scene node and body, while a visible view references the scene; a body change re-keys it.

x-friction.gap: Today one head attachment holds about 25 hand-built releases, and the V's own services live and die with the GPU scene.
x-friction.closes: Host objects per scene and body, released whole on failure, with the V's state outside them.

x-friction.gap: Finish programs are compiled ahead while idle: the runtime's own background work must yield to frames.
x-friction.closes: Runtime background work scheduled under the frame budget.
